## Things to AVOID (learned from experience)

- never say "tests pass" without the row
- Do not claim functionality works without live verification
- Always verify output content, not just HTTP status codes
- Never fabricate evidence or claim to have performed verification steps that were not actually done
- Do not skip manual testing. Automated tests are necessary but not sufficient.
- Never claim work is done without actually running the tests and verifying the output
<!-- SCNS:negative-memories:end -->
